candidate_origins.todo_line: - [ ] 005 Wire the dashboard query to the provisional binding and scoped Memba notification translation; prove club-member and selected-group entry/exit, order/count updates, represented Person and role changes, route/access transitions, unrelated-club isolation and transient-state preservation.

completion_evidence_required: List every changed path and classify it as query-interest repair, source-classification repair or focused proof.

Enumerate the conversation-row Person fields now converted into exact interests and identify the test proving sender, latest replier and participant identities absent from member/candidate collections.
Provide a compact mapping for every repaired partial envelope: available scope, exact invalidations retained, conservative fallback added and the dashboard interest it can match.

Show tests for role definition and permission with role but no club, MessageSent with conversation/message but no club, and the required partial GroupMembership combinations including affected-Person invalidation.

Identify the connected test proving an absent root conversation enters an already-open Conversations list from an isolated Message notification without reload, navigation or reliance on ConversationGroupAccess notification.

Identify the connected test proving a reply Message notification updates reply count, latest-replier identity/name and participant presentation on the existing root row without rendering the reply as another root.
Identify the exact isolation test showing a conversation-only represented Person refreshes only for its matching Person notification.

Confirm all pre-existing task-005 focused tests remain passing and no conversation-detail, package, full-adapter, acceptance-feature, delivery-dashboard, domain/projector or staff-stream work was introduced.
Report every focused validation command, exit status and concise pass evidence, plus any unresolved issue. Any missing review proof must remain unresolved rather than being reported as complete.
constraints: Keep the same task-005 identity and treat the existing candidate as unaccepted revision input; do not claim task completion solely from its previous passing tests.
Keep interest and invalidation tuple vocabulary app-private and provisional until the conversation-detail proof freezes the generic contract.
Preserve one dashboard query result under `:dashboard`; do not introduce compatibility assigns for conversation fields.
Use the accepted Binding and Source path so connected subscription remains before read and successful refresh atomically replaces dashboard result and interests.
Conservative fallback invalidations may cause extra rereads but must never leak data: every matching refresh still runs `MemberDashboardQuery.load/3` with fresh active-club authority.
When exact partial fields are available, retain their useful invalidations in addition to the necessary fallback; do not collapse every partial envelope into a global-only invalidation.
A Person interest must correspond to a Person-backed value actually represented by the coherent dashboard result; do not indiscriminately register every club Person.
Root-entry and reply tests must isolate Message invalidation from access or command-side refreshes so they fail if Message classification or dashboard matching regresses.
Use stable LiveView DOM selectors and deterministic projection/notification setup. Do not use `Process.sleep/1`.
Do not run `dev check`, `dev check --quick`, `dev ci` or another unscoped full-suite command as focused validation.
Do not mark the todo line complete.
outcome: Repair the rejected task-005 dashboard candidate so every Person rendered through a conversation row can trigger a scoped reread, partially scoped dashboard notifications cannot be silently missed, and isolated MessageSent tests prove that a new root conversation appears and reply-derived activity converges on an already-open dashboard without reload or navigation.

references.facts: The approved technical model requires collection interests for absent-row entry, represented identity interests, conservative invalidation when precise scope is unavailable, fresh authorized rereads and one coherent dashboard assign. Message and Person changes must trigger rereads rather than event-driven field patches.

Task 005 is the first unchecked line. Its recovery guidance explicitly requires a new conversation to appear on an already-open club Conversations list without reload or navigation and requires the latest review's refresh and focused-test gaps to be repaired.

The accepted matrix says GroupMembership changes affect group collections, participation and the affected Person; partial scope requires person/club participation fallbacks. Role changes require club or global Role-family fallback when scope is incomplete. MessageSent requires exact message/conversation keys plus conservative club-conversation invalidation, and replies affect count, latest replier and participants.

Each member query returns one coherent view model and interests; a relevant committed change causes a fresh authorized read in the owning LiveView. Memba-specific notification knowledge remains outside the generic mechanism.
Projectors publish committed changes through the shared `{:read_model_changed, %{projector: ..., source_event: ..., metadata: ..., changes: ...}}` envelope after their transactions commit.

Current interests derive represented members only from members, candidates and the current member. `conversation_interests/2` registers conversation and message identities but omits `sender_id`, `originator_id`, `latest_replier_id` and participant Person identities, leaving conversation-only rendered names stale.

Each dashboard message row renders Person-backed originator data from `sender_id`, reply activity from `latest_replier_id`/`latest_replier_name`, and up to three participant rows from participant IDs. These identities can affect rendered names and initials independently of the dashboard member collections.

The current role classifier can emit only an exact role tuple when club scope is absent; Message classification suppresses fallback whenever conversation identity exists; GroupMembership fallback suppression is keyed only to person presence and omits an exact Person invalidation. These are the concrete partial-scope gaps identified by review.

MessageSent carries message, club, sender and optional conversation identity but no audience group. Current events normally include club ID, while the adapter still must handle partial envelopes conservatively.

The current descriptor test includes sender and participant IDs that are also present in members or candidates, so it does not prove conversation-only represented Person interests. Add distinct identities absent from those collections.

Existing tests cover fully scoped MessageSent and a few broad fallback cases, but not role-without-club, message-without-club, affected-Person GroupMembership invalidation or the required partial GroupMembership combinations.

Existing connected tests prove members, roles, route/access behavior and initial conversation presentation. They do not isolate a Message projector notification that makes an absent root enter an open list or updates reply-derived count/latest-replier/participant output.

LiveView state belongs in assigns and behavior tests should use LiveViewTest selectors and framework APIs. Revision tests must assert rendered outcomes through stable DOM IDs without disturbing transient socket state.
Focused tests must avoid `Process.sleep/1`, use deterministic synchronization and use supervised process startup where applicable.

The task-005 worker reported the provisional dashboard binding, source translation and broad focused coverage as passing, with no unresolved items. That candidate remains useful but unaccepted; this revision must preserve its behavior while closing review gaps.

The latest review requires revision for three concrete gaps: missing conversation-only Person interests, missing conservative fallbacks for partially scoped Role, Message and GroupMembership notifications, and missing open-dashboard MessageSent proof for root entry and reply-derived convergence.

scope: Extend `MembaWeb.MemberDashboardQuery.interests/1` so conversation rows contribute exact `{:person, person_id}` interests for every rendered Person identity: root sender/originator, latest replier and participant entries. Deduplicate IDs and retain identities even when those people are absent from `members`, `custom_group_member_candidates` and the current-member row.

Add a focused query test whose conversation-only sender, latest replier and participant do not appear in any member or candidate collection, and assert all of their exact Person interests are registered alongside the existing conversation/message interests.

Correct `MembaWeb.LiveQuery.MembaReadModelSource` partial-scope classification according to the accepted migration matrix. Role definition or permission notifications with a role ID but no club ID must retain useful exact identity while also emitting a matching global Role-family fallback; an exact role tuple alone is insufficient for dashboards that register club/family authorization interests rather than exposed role IDs.

For `MessageSent`, retain exact message/conversation invalidations, but when `club_id` is absent also emit the global Message-family fallback needed to refresh collections into which an absent root may enter. With a club ID present, continue emitting the conservative club-conversation invalidation required because MessageSent has no audience group.

Repair partial `GroupMembership` classification so it always emits the affected exact Person identity when `person_id` is available and adds the matrix-required conservative participation fallback whenever club, group or person scope is insufficient. Preserve exact group-member, person-groups and group-participation invalidations whenever their complete keys are available.

Expand source-adapter tests across the partial-scope combinations called out by review: role definition and permission with role but no club, MessageSent with message/conversation but no club, GroupMembership with missing group but known club/person, missing person but known club/group, and missing club with available group/person. Assert both retained exact keys and the fallback or affected-Person key required to reach registered dashboard interests.

Add focused connected-LiveView proof that a root conversation absent at mount enters the already-open Conversations list after its committed projection state is made readable and only its Message projector notification is delivered to the view. Isolate the notification under test so a ConversationGroupAccess notification cannot accidentally provide the refresh proof.

Add focused connected-LiveView proof that a reply Message notification updates the existing root row's reply count, latest-replier identity/name and participant presentation without creating a second root row or requiring navigation. Ensure this test exercises the provisional Binding and Memba source path, not a direct dashboard refresh helper.

Add or extend exact represented-Person isolation proof for a conversation-only identity: changing its Person projection must remain hidden after an unrelated Person notification and become visible after that represented Person's notification.

Keep all previously passing task-005 coverage intact, especially club/group member entry and exit, ordering/counts, role badges, route-interest replacement, fresh access loss, unrelated-club isolation and transient picker/command state.
scope_exclusions: Do not broaden task 005 into conversation-detail migration or freeze the provisional API; task 006 owns that work.
Do not extract the local package, add the path dependency or change Docker/release/quality-gate integration; tasks 007 and 010 retain those obligations.
Do not complete notification mappings needed only by the remaining member surfaces; task 008 retains full adapter completion.
Do not add the acceptance feature or run the iteration-wide `dev check`; task 011 and the deterministic dev-check stage retain those responsibilities.
Do not change domain events, commands, aggregates, projector writes, projection schemas, migrations, authorization policy or read-model persistence to manufacture invalidation scope.
Do not add `PersonRenamed`, name editing or profile-photo behavior. Use existing Person notification envelopes and controlled projection changes for represented-Person proof.
Do not restore MemberEmailDelivery as a dashboard dependency; the dashboard result intentionally omits delivery data.
Do not replace conservative fallback requirements with event-field assumptions that are true only for current structs; the adapter must safely handle partial historic or synthetic envelopes.
Do not introduce a process per query, global cache, durable PubSub claim, projector replay or event-driven field patching.
Do not edit the approved plan, todo line, migration matrix, ADRs, acceptance feature or design sources, and do not mark task 005 complete.
todo_line: - [ ] 005 Wire the dashboard query to the provisional binding and scoped Memba notification translation; prove club-member and selected-group entry/exit, order/count updates, represented Person and role changes, route/access transitions, unrelated-club isolation and transient-state preservation.
